alive.last_commit_message:
fix(recon): use the local image when a docker pull fails, release 6.24.2

A DNS blip during an end-to-end scan made every `docker pull` fail, and
Katana and Hakrawler were skipped ("Image/setup unavailable") although
both images were in the local store; the scan ran with no crawler.

pull_image_or_use_local() still pulls first, so a :latest tag stays
current when the registry is reachable, and falls back to the copy on
the host when the pull fails or times out. Katana, Hakrawler, GAU, ZAP,
Nuclei and the docker-katana helper all go through it now; a guard test
keeps a bare `docker pull` from coming back in any of them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
